content.short: AFI Protocol runs proof-of-reserve vaults paying yield backed by gold and other real assets.
content.description: AFI Protocol verifies the assets and liabilities behind tokenized real-world assets on an hourly cycle and publishes proof of solvency on-chain without revealing individual positions. Coverage spans treasuries, gold, private credit, stablecoins, equities and real estate on over a hundred blockchains. Issuers submit to verification to reach allocators and lenders, and a public dashboard shows each one's current status. AFI also operates vaults that pay yield on tokenized assets and admit only issuers that have passed verification.
content.meta: Gold-backed and real-asset vaults on Monad, published with proof-of-reserve attestations.
